contracts.title: Guest browsing
contracts.description: Guest browsing governs published home catalog projection; Return only published, serviceable listings and resilient media without creating customer state.

denied: revoked or suspended guest customer
actor outside service region and listing outlet
actor presenting a resource outside service region and listing outlet

preconditions: A service region and at least one publication state are defined.
catalog unchanged is the authoritative starting state for published home catalog projection.
successBehavior: Return only published, serviceable listings and resilient media without creating customer state.
Return only the fields declared by browse home catalog for service region and listing outlet.
errorBehavior: POSTAL_CODE_INVALID returns the standard error envelope and leaves published home catalog projection at its last committed version.
CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE returns the standard error envelope and leaves published home catalog projection at its last committed version.
databaseInvariants: browse home catalog does not mutate published home catalog projection; it reads service region and listing outlet from one committed snapshot.

denied: revoked or suspended guest customer
actor outside service region and listing outlet
actor presenting a resource outside service region and listing outlet
ownershipRules: Authorize service region and listing outlet on the server before reading or changing published home catalog projection.
Reject cross-role, cross-tenant, cross-outlet, or foreign-resource identifiers without revealing existence.

tenantOutletIsolation: Scope every published home catalog projection read to service region and listing outlet.
A foreign identifier is denied before any published home catalog projection data is disclosed or mutated.

idempotency.reason: Guest browsing observes published home catalog projection without creating or changing a business result.

concurrency.reason: Guest browsing must not combine incompatible versions of published home catalog projection in one response.
behavior: Read published home catalog projection from one committed snapshot and discard stale client responses.

offlineRetry.reason: Guest browsing has an explicit connectivity and reconnect rule for published home catalog projection.
behavior: safe-read-cache

observability.reason: Guest browsing needs a diagnosable outcome without exposing credentials or private resource data.
behavior: Emit CUS-DISC-001, the operation, actor class, outcome code, trace ID, and latency.
Redact credentials and private fields of published home catalog projection.

audit.reason: Guest browsing is an ordinary non-privileged read and does not create a business audit event.
behavior: Operational access logs still follow the observability rule for CUS-DISC-001.

accessibility.reason: Guest browsing has a user-visible state that must work with keyboard, screen reader, text scaling, and non-color cues.
behavior: Label controls and published home catalog projection status, preserve logical focus, and announce errors and recovery.

businessDecision.reason: Guest browsing does not depend on an unresolved business decision in the P0 catalog.

unit: Exercise Guest browsing boundaries, POSTAL_CODE_INVALID, CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE, and the catalog unchanged to catalog unchanged decision.
component: Render Guest browsing loading, success, empty, denied, stale, offline, and recovery states with accessible semantics.
integration: Verify published home catalog projection ownership, the state transition, and database invariants against PostgreSQL and deterministic providers.
contract: Validate browse home catalog fields, stable errors, authorization, and applicability rules.
e2e: Drive guest customer through Guest browsing and verify the resulting published home catalog projection projection.

stateTransitions.idempotencyAndCorrelation: The decision key binds REJECT and reasonCode to the expected order version; orderId correlates compensation and visibility events.
